creditPolicy: Explicit printed credits (1/2, 1 1/2, 2) are kept. Yale states that most courses carry one credit and that variations are noted. When a 2026–2027 course page prints '0 Course cr' or omits the credit, Trajectory stores 1.0 and marks creditStatus. BIOL modules whose descriptions say they meet for half a term are stored as 0.5.

listingKey.asterisk: YCPS key: a star marks a limited-enrollment seminar. The 2026–2027 pages also star some standard lectures; the marker is preserved, not treated as cancellation.
listingKey.brackets: YCPS key: a bracketed course is not offered in the current catalog year but is expected the succeeding year.
listingKey.a or b: Fall and spring listings of the same course.
